honest_limits.sentence: Signal track records come from one 43-firm, between-firm backtest and published return studies; they rank evidence types to within about a factor of two and are shown as tiers, not exact probabilities.
Text and call findings without a mapped dollar channel are shown with their evidence tier and no dollar figure, and stay out of the top-five table.
Materiality divides by the company's usual quarterly EPS miss, annualized by an assumed factor of two; impacts one to two years out are compared on that near-term scale.
When consensus for the affected year did not exist before the disclosure, we cannot test whether analysts priced it, and we assume a 50% chance they did.
AstraZeneca and Novo Nordisk have no earnings release in our index, so their headline term is imputed from the other eight; Novo's dollar-based policy channels are not converted.
Several signal families in the design (insider sales, 8-K items, misstatement scores, gross-to-net, footnotes) have no detector yet; patent-loss inputs are thin for four companies.
With ten companies no ranking can be statistically significant (minimum p = 0.10); we show the pick rests on the cited findings table and a human red-team read instead.
Scenario weights are a launch base rate applied to every move, and the bear and bull multipliers are boundary values, so the scenario spread is understated and the value leans optimistic.
69,553 facts in the store, 10,963 of them page-verified.

verifier_rules: The quote must appear on the cited page (whitespace-normalized).
For call transcripts, the named speaker must appear before the quote.
Every figure cited must appear on that page.
LLM-written summaries (for example fool.com transcripts) are rejected as sources; only primary documents count.
Label facts must occur verbatim in the drug's DailyMed label (label_sections.md), cited by section.
Transcripts flagged unquotable (duplicate, no speaker names, garbled) are never quoted.
limits: Probabilities and weights are judgment calls, tuned on a small backtest.
Obscurity depends on transcript and news coverage we can actually gather.
Policy shocks (MFN terms after 2029, FDA timing) are scenarios, not forecasts.
Forensic signals predict margin compression, not hard events (revenue drops or impairments); lift on hard events is statistically indistinguishable from 1 (out/backtest/hit_rates.json).
Findings marked needs_human passed no automatic check that would let us call them verified; they are shown, labelled, and never used for stance dollars.
The CEO memo in this export is drafted from verified findings by rules, not written by a model.
